title: Ultrasound deep learning predicts papillary thyroid cancer aggressiveness
summary: A deep-learning model was developed on preoperative ultrasound images from 1,023 patients. The DL-Clinic model reached AUCs of 0.834, 0.759 and 0.750 in internal, external and prospective test sets, and the DL score was the strongest independent predictor. Exploratory analyses linked model-derived imaging phenotypes to transcriptomic pathways and need independent validation.
ai_technology: Deep-learning model on ultrasound images with Grad-CAM regional activation analysis
organization: First Affiliated Hospital of Anhui Medical University

evidence.tested: Discrimination was assessed in internal, external and prospective test sets, with exploratory GSEA of transcriptomic correlates.
evidence.unknown: AUCs are modest; the transcriptomic associations are exploratory. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep-learning model predicted aggressiveness from ultrasound, and Grad-CAM activations were related to pathways.
